message.content:
Fetching video metadata and transcripts using `run_command`.
```python
cmd = """python -c "
import json, yt_dlp
from youtube_transcript_api import YouTubeTranscriptApi

ydl_opts = {'skip_download': True}
with yt_dlp.YoutubeDL(ydl_opts) as ydl:
    info = ydl.extract_info('https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=L1vXCYZAYYM', download=False)
    print('TITLE:', info.get('title'))
    print('DESCRIPTION:', info.get('description'))

try:
    transcript = YouTubeTranscriptApi.get_transcript('L1vXCYZAYYM')
    for line in transcript:
        text = line['text']
        if any(w in text.lower() for w in ['species', 'bird', 'simultaneous', 'camera', 'highest', 'record', 'most', 'at once', 'same time', 'together']):
            print(f\\\"{line['start']}: {text}\\\")
except Exception as e:
    print('TRANSCRIPT ERROR:', e)
"
"""
res = await run_command(cmd)
print(res)
```
